entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I suddenly remembered watching her..."
entries.dialogueText: I suddenly remembered watching her give a speech in this very auditorium, nearly 30 years ago.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The person in front of me was much..."
entries.dialogueText: The person in front of me was much older, but had the exact same fire in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We meet *again*. I saw you speak w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We meet *again*. I saw you speak when I was studying here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Romus the Merciful, you mean. You'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus the Merciful, you mean. You're welcome."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're the mother of my future son..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the mother of my future son-in-law. I couldn't let you rot away on that island."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am so sorry about your son.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am so sorry about your son."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duchess Sazon. It is a pleasure to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Sazon. It is a pleasure to see you here in Iza."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Oh, that's terribly embarrassing...."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, that's terribly embarrassing. I'm sure I was parroting whatever revolutionary nonsense my husband was filling my head with at the time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your husband. Right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your husband. Right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucas had the right idea. But his..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucas had the right idea. But his methods left something to be desired."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't blame him for what he did...."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't blame him for what he did. Rizia was hungry for change. It still is."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Yes, thank you, Your Majesty. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, thank you, Your Majesty. I'm happy to be home again."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""At the same time, it fills me with..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the same time, it fills me with shame to think about my last days here. The things my husband did..."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Likewise, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Likewise, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I watched your coronation from Cal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I watched your coronation from Caleqabiz. It disgusted me to think how close my husband came to keeping you from the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You were as guilty as your husband..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were as guilty as your husband was. But you redeemed yourself by turning him in."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Yes, Manus' unfortunate absence ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Manus' unfortunate absence has tainted the joy of my return."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I am ashamed to think that he inhe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am ashamed to think that he inherited his father's treasonous tendencies. I thought I raised him better than that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't seriously expect me to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't seriously expect me to believe you don't share those tendencies."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I wouldn't call it rotting, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't call it rotting, Your Majesty. Manus and I were treated the same as any other villager on Caleqabiz."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked fondly at Manus and Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked fondly at Manus and Vina.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""But yes, it warms my heart to see..."
entries.dialogueText: "But yes, it warms my heart to see my son and the Crown Princess so happy together. A sign that our houses are finally reconciling after my husband's shameful act."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I won't pretend his words never sw..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't pretend his words never swayed me. But when I became pregnant I realized some things are more important than revolution."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""A revolution bought with blood wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "A revolution bought with blood will never succeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes traveled past me to the he..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes traveled past me to the heavily armed officers patrolling the auditorium aisles.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""A revolution bought with blood wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "A revolution bought with blood will never succeed."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I was about to become a mother. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was about to become a mother. That mattered more to me than any revolution."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Maybe I did once. But when I becam..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe I did once. But when I became pregnant I realized some things are more important than revolution."

entries.dialogueText: A flash of sorrow crossed her face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes traveled past me to her so..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes traveled past me to her son.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I should be getting to my seat. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should be getting to my seat. We will speak again soon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes traveled past me to Rico,..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes traveled past me to Rico, who was already sitting onstage.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can change Rizia together. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can change Rizia together. It's not too late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'll get your seat, all right. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll get your seat, all right. Sooner than you think."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enjoy the festivities, Duchess.""
entries.dialogueText: "Enjoy the festivities, Duchess."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Try not to blame yourself for what..."
entries.dialogueText: "Try not to blame yourself for what happened. Focus on the future."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Please, Your Majesty. Call me Ange..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. Call me Angelica."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded, stepped away and contin..."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded, stepped away and continued down the aisle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a confused look, she continued..."
entries.dialogueText: With a confused look, she continued down the aisle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stepped away from me and contin..."
entries.dialogueText: She stepped away from me and continued down the aisle.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I will. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will. Thank you."
